metadata.title: Fintech Internal Tools — Power Apps Prototype
metadata.description: A 2-hour prototype replicating the core Power Apps capabilities used by a fintech internal-tools team.

home.title: Could Two Hours of Building Replace a $250K/Year Platform?
home.intro: A Series C fintech with ~60 engineers runs three internal apps on Microsoft Power Apps. This prototype rebuilds their capability core — data grids, validated forms, role-based access control, and a full audit trail — so the build-vs-buy decision rests on evidence, not guesswork.
home.tryIt: Try it: switch between Viewer, Approver, and Admin in the top-right and watch what each role can and can't do.
home.prototypeNote: Prototype note: data lives in memory and reseeds on cold starts — a deliberate scope cut, discussed in the evaluation.
home.kycDescription: Work through pending identity checks. Approve, reject, or escalate — rejections and escalations always require a note.
home.refundsDescription: See open exposure at a glance, decide on requests, and process approved payouts. Refunds over 1,000 need an admin.
home.flagsDescription: Toggle flags and dial rollout percentages per environment. Every change is admin-only and lands in the audit log.
home.researchDescription: What Power Apps actually provides, and which slice of it this team pays $250K/year for.
home.evaluationDescription: What ~2 hours of building replicated, what it didn't, and what closing the gap would really cost.
home.recommendationDescription: The build-vs-buy call, with the reasoning laid out so you can disagree with it productively.
